bio:
Adi Gunawan dikenal melalui karya-karya patung berbahan perunggu yang memadukan kekuatan teknik dengan eksplorasi simbolik. Dalam praktik artistiknya, ia menjadikan figur manusia, terutama perempuan, serta berbagai jenis binatang sebagai elemen utama untuk membangun narasi visual yang kaya makna. 

Sosok perempuan dalam patung-patungnya sering ditampilkan secara kontradiktif terhadap standar kecantikan konvensional seperti tubuh kurus, langsing, atau berambut halus. Melalui pendekatan tersebut, Adi menawarkan pembacaan yang lebih luas mengenai keberagaman tubuh, karakter, dan pengalaman manusia. Simbol-simbol binatang yang dihadirkannya, seperti babi, anjing, kucing, kuda, dan berbagai fauna lainnya, berakar pada ingatan serta pengalaman masa kecil.

karya.deskripsi:
The harmony between motion and melody. The rhythm of life and the freedom of the open road  converge. This piece captures the courage to stay true to oneself, especially in unfamiliar territory. It 
celebrates the defiance of societal expectations, the strength to forget ahead, and the unwavering confidence to keep moving forward, no mater what others say. The piece is a reminder that even as the “new kid,” it’s about staying focused, fighting for your place, and owning your unique path. It’s a tribute to those who ride to their own beat.

A whimsical twist on form and color, featuring a long, yellow-colored pig that stretches with an almost comical elongation. It celebrates individuality and the delightful surprises that come with embracing one’s unique characteristics. Its exaggerated form challenges conventional perspectives, inviting viewers to  appreciate the humor and creativity inherent in everyday objects, highlighting the importance of humor and creativity in life, suggesting that growth and self-expression can be joyful processes.

karya.judul: Beyond The Potrait, Into The Ride
karya.deskripsi: The freedom of leaving the familiar behind. The stillness of the portrait gives way to movement, as Mona Lisa steps beyond the frame and into an unexpected journey. The car becomes a symbol of curiosity, freedom, and the desire to experience a world beyond what is already known. For centuries, we have known her as a legend frozen in a single moment, but perhaps there is another side to her story—one that longs to wander, to explore, and to discover places beyond the walls of the portrait. Somewhere beyond the frame, the legendary Mona Lisa may simply be living the life we never knew she wanted: traveling, exploring, and seeing the world for herself.
